gaps.sentence: He denied ___ the vase, though the camera saw him.
She made me ___ my homework before dinner.
gaps.explanation: 'make somebody do' — bare infinitive after the object.

gaps.sentence: He's the man ___ car was stolen.
gaps.explanation: 'whose' shows possession: the man whose car…

gaps.sentence: I'd rather not ___ about it over the phone.
He prefers cycling ___ driving to work.
The letters ___ delivered every morning at eight.
She was ___ the impression that the interview was today.
gaps.explanation: 'Under the impression that …' = believing, perhaps wrongly.

gaps.sentence: You'd better hurry, ___ you'll miss the flight.
gaps.explanation: 'Otherwise' = if you do not, then this will happen.
